description:
This is a new requirement is for the demo and replacement of the existing roofing systems of the Dining Facility (DFAC). This requirement shall include the procurement of all necessary resources, including plant management, supervision, labor, tools, supplies, parts, equipment, related services, and applicable licenses and permits to successfully complete the project as outlined in the SOW and project specifications. 


The roof membrane manufacturer shall furnish a 20-year, no dollar limit (NDL) roof system materials and installation workmanship warranty.
